title: Understanding Boxplots
text: A boxplot displays the distribution of data based on a five-number summary: minimum, first quartile (Q1), median, third quartile (Q3), and maximum. The median is the line inside the box. Compare the medians of the two groups to determine which is higher.

title: Comparing Medians
text: Look at the line inside each box in the boxplot. This line represents the median. Compare the position of these lines for Tutors and TAs to see which is higher.
